name: ESP32 S1-ADV
description: Self-hosted ESP32-S3 AI agent bridge for Cardputer ADV: OpenClaw text/voice chat, device status, and optional self-updating firmware through reviewed builds and OTA delivery.

allowRoot.description: Explicit exception for a root HTTP worker. Prefer an unprivileged Gateway or the isolated standalone service.

configPath.description: Absolute path to the private bridge configuration generated by s1-adv init.

autoStart.description: Start the bridge with the Gateway. Enable only after reviewing its generated configuration.
